description: This file defines an Express.js route module for handling CRUD operations related to LLM (Large Language Model) cost records. It includes middleware for authentication, tenant resolution, and scope enforcement, as well as route handlers for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting LLM cost entries. The file also contains Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list LLM cost records, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination via the built CRUD controller.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new LLM cost record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific LLM cost record by ID.
